why: The Connes embedding problem was resolved negatively via the MIP*=RE result (Ji, Natarajan, Vidick, Wright, Yuen), announced January 2020 and published in Communications of the ACM in 2021 — this predates the January 2024 snapshot, so the Wikipedia list appears stale on this entry. A February 2025 arXiv paper independently constructs a non-Connes-embeddable tracial von Neumann algebra without relying on MIP*=RE.

found.title: MIP*=RE
found.note: Preprint proving MIP*=RE, which as a corollary gives a negative resolution to the Connes embedding problem; event predates the Jan 2024 snapshot.

found.title: There Is An Equivalence Relation Whose von Neumann Algebra Is Not Connes Embeddable
found.note: Preprint giving an independent construction of a non-Connes-embeddable tracial von Neumann algebra.
